name: BOM-inspection_required-description
value: When checked: finishing a Work Order made with this BOM will require a Quality Inspection of the produced item (using the template below) before the manufacture entry can be submitted. This is the final inspection (PDI) gate.

name: Item-inspection_required_before_delivery-description
value: When checked: a Delivery Note containing this item cannot be submitted until an accepted Outgoing Quality Inspection exists for it. This is the dispatch gate — nothing ships uninspected.
